title: RailsConf 2014 - Keynote: Writing Software by David Heinemeier Hansson
summary: David Heinemeier Hansson's RailsConf 2014 keynote argues that programming is closer to writing than to science, with clear code produced by iterating through drafts. It prioritizes clarity and craft over technical superiority.
why: HN points to it in discussions of programming as a creative craft and of how to write clear software.

quote.text: I really like this[1] talk from DHH on the subject
